cells.tense: You are seeing the full shape of something before anyone else has it, and that is now a deliberate act.
cells.ask: Pick the one read you are surest of and act on it today, before the rest of the picture is in.
cells.core:
You're seeing the whole thing early. The trail is there in the details before anyone has spoken about it, and you're not guessing — you're reading. The recognition lands, it's yours, and the answer that comes out is usually right.

What keeps it clean is what you do with it. A read that gets spoken gets tested and grows; a read you hold back stays your private sharpness and costs you the ordinary pleasure of a thing being shared. Tell someone what you've found out, out loud, today. Not to be right — to let the finding be a common thing instead of a possession.

cells.tense: You will be braced for the next turn, already working the pattern that has not happened yet.
cells.ask: Name where this ends, set one thing in place, and leave it alone for a week.
cells.core:
You're ahead of it — the next decision worked through before it arrives. It feels like being prepared. It also means you're rarely where you actually are: you reach the conversation with an answer that is days old and call it foresight.

Working well, this is a read that settles a room — clear, reliable, things make sense in your presence. Pushed ahead of the days themselves, the analysis gets spent on arrangements that don't exist yet, and the tone turns to pressure: finishing sentences, resenting people for being slow. Pick the one thing you have already worked out, say what it means, and let the actual days decide the rest.

cells.tense: You were reading the room back then and you stopped, and you are still standing where the reading stopped.
cells.ask: Tell one person the pattern you have already seen in your own situation.
cells.core:
The reads have gone quiet. The old ones still feel true, so they get carried around like a map from another town — and new situations get folded into them. It isn't bad intelligence. It is a way of seeing that stopped being used on anything unfamiliar.

What a working read looks like is not certainty. It is bringing what you notice to someone else and letting the telling change it. There is one thing about your own situation you have known for a while and not said. Say it once, plainly, to one person who can hear it. Whatever comes back will do work the quiet can't.
cells.sheetLine: You stopped telling anyone what you already see.

cells.tense: You are already working the pattern in a room you keep saying you are only passing through.
cells.ask: Pick one read you call "just the way it is" and say out loud, once, that you made it.
cells.core:
You notice things. You also say none of it is you — it's the situation, the facts, the obvious. Meanwhile the shape of what counts as obvious in a room has been quietly arranged by you, and you take no credit for the arranging.

Working well, this is a read offered as a read: here is what I see, take it or leave it. That's a light thing to hold, and it gets joined and corrected without anyone losing face. The next time you see something, call it yours out loud and hold it lightly. If joining a thing stops feeling like surrender, the room changes, and so does the person standing in it.
